headline: This cannot be done as you asked, so no workflow is offered for it.
points: "run PUMA on our endometrium data" -- not available here as asked. NetZoo runs PUMA with its package defaults and passes no settings to it, so "with alpha raised to 0.25" cannot be applied. PUMA itself can still run, with its own settings instead -- an alternative, not the setting you asked for.
